data.one_liner: An easy-to-use method call debouncer and throttler package for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a straightforward mechanism to debounce or throttle function calls using unique tags. It handles delaying or ignoring subsequent calls over specified durations.
use_when: You need to debounce text input search queries to prevent excessive network requests.
You want to throttle button taps to prevent duplicate actions.
avoid_when: You require complex reactive stream-based operators instead of simple timer-based wrappers.
strengths: Extremely easy to use with static tag-based methods.
Pure Dart package with no external dependencies.
weaknesses: Relies on global tags which might lead to naming collisions in large applications.
